title: Thorns in the Path
key: E minor (B section in G major)
instruments: oboe-like double reed (lead), bassoon-like reed, violin section, flute (hhsynth), marimba ostinato, pizzicato strings, upright pluck bass (hhsynth), string pad (hhsynth), taiko, frame drum, brush, dark ticks, shaker (hhsynth), hall reverb 1.7 s
